included.title: Standard deployment
included.description: Every project ends with a complete deployment on the client's server. No extra costs, no surprises.
items: Uploading the application to the client's server (VPS, dedicated, cloud)
Production environment configuration (PHP, MySQL, Redis)
Nginx configuration and SSL certificate (Let's Encrypt)
Domain connection and test launch
Database migrations and seed data
Delivery of .env file with environment configuration
Brief launch documentation and environment variables guide

addon.title: Advanced DevOps deployment
addon.description: For clients requiring higher standards of infrastructure, automation and security.
items: Docker + Docker Compose containerization (isolated environment)
CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI) — automatic deploy on push
Staging and production environment setup (dev → staging → prod)
Server and application monitoring (uptime, email/SMS alerts)
Automated database backups (cron + S3/external storage)
Server hardening: firewall, fail2ban, SSH key-only access
Reverse proxy and load balancer configuration

code.title: Source code access

items: Private GitHub or GitLab repository — owner access
Full commit history with change descriptions
README with installation and launch instructions
Code written to standards (PSR-12, ESLint) — readable by any developer

mainStack.title: What we use

devops.subtitle: Modern tools that ensure stability, performance and application security.

why.title: Why this stack
why.subtitle: We have used it for years. Maintenance cost is predictable, and the next team does not have to learn an experiment.
why.note: We do not promise “this year’s hottest framework”. We promise code that can still be extended after launch.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: PHP 8.3 with JIT, Vue 3 with Proxy-based reactivity, MySQL 8 with query optimizer - every element is optimized.

security.title: Security
security.description: Laravel has built-in protection against the most common attacks. Regular updates and active community.

scalability.title: Scalability
scalability.description: From a small website to an application serving thousands of users. This stack grows with your business.

community.title: Community
community.description: Millions of developers, thousands of packages, hundreds of tutorials. An actively developed and maintained ecosystem.

laravel.title: Laravel
laravel.description: Laravel is our main backend choice - a stable framework with a mature ecosystem and active community:
laravel.eloquentDesc: intuitive database work without writing raw SQL
laravel.securityDesc: protection against SQL injection, XSS, CSRF

vue.title: Vue.js 3
vue.description: Vue.js is a progressive JavaScript framework that combines simplicity with powerful capabilities. Composition API in Vue 3 simplifies code organization:
vue.reactivityDesc: automatic change tracking and DOM update
vue.sfcDesc: HTML, CSS and JS in one file
vue.piniaDesc: modern state management with TypeScript support

mysql.title: MySQL 8
mysql.description: MySQL is a proven and reliable database management system. Version 8 brought significant improvements in performance and functionality:

postgresql.title: PostgreSQL
postgresql.description: PostgreSQL is an advanced object-relational database management system. Known for reliability, standards compliance and extensive features:
postgresql.advancedDesc: JSON, XML, arrays, ranges and custom types

tailwind.title: TailwindCSS
tailwind.description: Tailwind changed the way we think about CSS. Utility-first approach allows building unique interfaces without writing custom CSS:

docker.title: Docker
docker.description: Containerization ensures identical environment at every stage - from development to production. No more "it works on my machine".

nginx.title: Nginx
nginx.description: High-performance HTTP server and reverse proxy. Handles many connections simultaneously with minimal resource usage.

redis.title: Redis
redis.description: In-memory data store for caching, sessions and queues. Speeds up applications by reducing database queries.

git.title: Git & GitHub
git.description: Version control is fundamental. Git allows tracking every change, collaborating in teams and safely deploying changes.

linux.title: Linux
linux.description: Stable, secure and efficient operating system for production servers.

vite.title: Vite
vite.description: Lightning-fast next-generation build tool. Hot Module Replacement in milliseconds - instant feedback during development.

android.sectionSubtitle: We build native Android apps in Kotlin with modern UI based on Jetpack Compose and Material Design 3 — fast, elegant and available on billions of devices.

kotlin.title: Kotlin
kotlin.description: Kotlin is the official programming language for Android recommended by Google. It combines concise syntax with full type safety and great interoperability with the Java ecosystem:
kotlin.nullSafetyDesc: the compiler eliminates NullPointerException — the most common source of app crashes
kotlin.coroutinesDesc: asynchronous operations (network, database) without blocking the UI thread
kotlin.extensionsDesc: readable, concise code — data classes, sealed classes, lambdas
kotlin.interopDesc: full access to Java libraries and the entire Android SDK ecosystem

compose.title: Jetpack Compose
compose.description: Jetpack Compose is Google's modern declarative UI toolkit for Android. It replaces traditional XML layouts with pure Kotlin code — less code, more power:
compose.declarativeDesc: you describe how the screen should look for a given state — Compose updates the UI automatically
compose.stateDesc: reactive state management — the screen refreshes automatically when data changes
compose.animationDesc: smooth animations and screen transitions in a single line of code
compose.previewDesc: UI component preview in Android Studio without running the app

material3.title: Material Design 3
material3.description: Material Design 3 (Material You) is Google's latest design system. It defines a consistent visual language for Android apps — from typography through components to adaptive colors. Our apps look native on every device and comply with Google Play guidelines:
material3.dynamicColorDesc: color palette adapts automatically to the system wallpaper (Android 12+)
material3.componentsDesc: TopAppBar, NavigationBar, FAB, Card, Dialog, TextField and dozens more
material3.themingDesc: consistent design throughout the app via a color and typography token system
material3.accessibilityDesc: built-in support for TalkBack, contrast requirements and system font sizes

ecosystem.subtitle: Proven libraries we use in every Android project

chat.description: Internal company chat with channels, file sharing and project integration.
chat.fullDescription: The system can include: topic channels and direct messages, file and document sharing, task management system integration, emoji reactions and threads, push and web notifications, chat history search. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + WebSockets + Redis.

agencyweb.title: Creative Agency Website
agencyweb.description: Professional website for a marketing or design agency with a portfolio.
agencyweb.fullDescription: The site can include: portfolio presentation with category filters, animated services section, team and competencies section, project brief form, blog and case studies, SEO and Core Web Vitals optimisation. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + TailwindCSS.

constructionweb.title: Construction Company Website
constructionweb.description: Business website for a construction firm with project gallery and quote form.
constructionweb.fullDescription: The site can include: project gallery filtered by type (houses, commercial, renovations), online quote form, building certificates and accreditations, service area map, FAQ section, Google Maps integration. Stack: Laravel + TailwindCSS + Alpine.js.

clinicweb.title: Medical Clinic Website
clinicweb.description: Website for a clinic or GP practice with online appointment booking.
clinicweb.fullDescription: The site can include: specialist list with profiles and timetable, online booking without registration, test information and price list, test results for logged-in patients, GDPR and privacy policy, location and hours. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + MySQL.

lawweb.title: Law Firm Website
lawweb.description: Prestigious website for a law firm with a legal blog and consultation form.
lawweb.fullDescription: The site can include: lawyer profiles and specialisations, SEO legal blog with articles, free consultation form, anonymised case outcomes section, bar association memberships, Polish-English bilingual version. Stack: Laravel + TailwindCSS + Vue.js.

eventweb.title: Conference or Event Website
eventweb.description: Landing page for an industry conference with registration and speaker agenda.
eventweb.fullDescription: The site can include: event agenda with schedule, speaker and sponsor profiles, online registration, live streaming and post-event VOD, interactive venue/stage map, attendee networking and matchmaking. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + Stripe + MySQL.

gymweb.title: Gym or Fitness Centre Website
gymweb.description: Website for a gym, fitness club or CrossFit box with membership pricing.
gymweb.fullDescription: The site can include: membership pricing with online purchase, group class timetable, trainer profiles, facility and equipment gallery, free trial session form, member reviews. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + Stripe + MySQL.

portfolioweb.title: Photographer or Creator Portfolio
portfolioweb.description: Elegant portfolio for a photographer, videographer or designer with gallery.
portfolioweb.fullDescription: The site can include: photo gallery with lightbox, category split (wedding, commercial, portrait), quote request form, blog with tips and behind-the-scenes, Instagram integration, local SEO. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + TailwindCSS.

marketplace.title: C2C / B2C Marketplace Platform
marketplace.description: Multi-vendor marketplace for products sold by third-party sellers.
marketplace.fullDescription: The platform can include: seller panel with products and orders, seller commissions and payouts, buyer–seller rating system, secure escrow payments, dispute and return management, product search and filters. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + Stripe Connect + MySQL.

posystem.title: POS System (Point of Sale)
posystem.description: Online cash register for restaurants, shops or cafes with reports.
posystem.fullDescription: The system can include: cashier interface on a tablet, fiscal printer integration, menu and product management, real-time stock levels, daily and weekly sales reports, online order and delivery integration. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + MySQL + WebSockets.

telemedicine.title: Telemedicine Platform
telemedicine.description: Online doctor consultation system with e-prescriptions and patient records.
telemedicine.fullDescription: The platform can include: video consultations with specialist doctors, e-prescriptions and e-referrals, patient health record with visit history, lab and test result integration, specialist chat, private billing. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + WebRTC + MySQL.

gymmanagement.title: Gym Management System
gymmanagement.description: Software for gyms with memberships, class schedules and access control.
gymmanagement.fullDescription: The system can include: membership and class package sales, group class timetable with sign-ups, card or app access control, member records with measurements, personal trainer billing, mobile app for clients. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + Android + MySQL.

property.title: Property Management System
property.description: System for property managers, housing communities and landlords.
property.fullDescription: The system can include: unit and tenant records, rent and utility billing, payment demand generation, tenant fault reports, contract and document management, financial reports for owners. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + MySQL + Twilio SMS.

schoollms.title: School Education Platform
schoollms.description: LMS for schools with electronic register, homework, and grades.
schoollms.fullDescription: The platform can include: electronic register with grades and attendance, homework and deadlines, educational materials and videos, online tests and exams, teacher–parent communication, timetable and substitute teacher management. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + MySQL + WebSockets.

insurance.title: Insurance Portal
insurance.description: System for selling and managing insurance policies online.
insurance.fullDescription: The portal can include: premium calculator with offer comparison, online policy purchase with e-signature, claim reporting with photo upload, claim status tracking, policy expiry reminders, insurer database integration. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + MySQL + Redis.

freelancer.title: Freelancer Platform
freelancer.description: Service connecting freelancers with clients: job listings and project quotes.
freelancer.fullDescription: The platform can include: freelancer profiles with portfolio and reviews, job posting by companies, bidding and price negotiation, escrow for secure payments, online contracts and invoices, post-project ratings. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + Stripe + MySQL.

eventmgmt.title: Event Management System
eventmgmt.description: Comprehensive event organisation platform with ticketing and accreditation.
eventmgmt.fullDescription: The system can include: event creation with agenda and speakers, ticket sales in multiple categories, QR code accreditation at entry, event page with registration, sponsor and exhibitor management, mobile app for attendees. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + Android + Stripe + MySQL.

transport.title: CRM for Transport Companies
transport.description: System for managing transport orders, fleet and drivers.
transport.fullDescription: The system can include: client and shipper database, full truck load and groupage order management, driver and vehicle assignment, GPS fleet tracking, CMR and transport documents, driver and client billing, freight exchange integration. Stack: Laravel + Vue.js + Google Maps + MySQL + Redis.
